writing.exampleCaption: The annotation tells parse which numeric type to produce.
writing.explanation: parse is generic: the destination type tells it what grammar to use. Because arbitrary text may be invalid, the result is Result rather than a bare value. A type annotation or turbofish such as parse::<i32>() resolves the target type, after which match, ?, or another deliberate policy handles failure.
writing.feedback: Annotate the binding or call parse::<i32>() so inference has a target.
